headline: Amending Council Rules and Ethics Ordinance to change the City Council agenda publication timeline.
summary: The meeting will consider a City Council referral on changing the timeline for publishing council agendas. The agenda also includes approval of October 20, 2026 draft minutes.
items: Changing the timeline for publishing City Council agendas, under the Council Rules and Ethics Ordinance
location: City Hall 2nd Floor Conference Room, 37 Green Street
plain_text:
City Council Rules Committee  
November 30, 2026   
City Hall 2nd Floor Conference Room 
37 Green Street 
3:30 PM  
 
1. Call to Order by Councilor Kretovic, Committee Chair. 
 
2. Roll Call. 
 
3. Approval of Meeting Minutes. 
 
o October 20, 2026 Draft Meeting Minutes 
 
4. Meeting overview by Councilor Kretovic, Committee Chair.    
 
5. Items to be Considered Regarding the Amendment of Council Rules/Ethics Ordinance.  
 
o Referral from City Council for consideration to amend the City Council agenda 
publication timeline. 
 
6. Other Business. 
 
7. Scheduling of Next Meeting, if necessary. 
 
8. Adjournment.   
 
 
This meeting is open to the public although there is no public input or testimony.
